sentences.cn_source: 他们在学习商业管理理论并将其付诸实践方面表现优异。

sentences.cn_source: Dub 可以在多种手机上运行，让你可以通过电子方式交换名片，甚至可以与不使用这项服务的人交换名片。

trans.cn_source: 商业计划：一份总结了商业所有者、经理或企业家打算如何组织创业活动并实施必要和足够使企业成功的活动的摘要。

sentences.c: I'm trying to keep off fatty foods.
sentences.cn_source: 我尽量不吃高脂肪食物。

sentences.c: Some foods are more fattening than others.
sentences.cn_source: 有些食物比较容易使人发胖。

sentences.c: Most foods that we eat are safe for birds.
sentences.cn_source: 我们吃的绝大部分食物对鸟类是安全的。

trans.cn: Nguồn thức ăn (nuốt)
trans.cn_source: 食物来源 ( 吞 )

trans.cn: Nguồn thực phẩm: đề cập đến cách thức hoặc nguồn thông qua đó con người hoặc động vật có được thức ăn.
trans.cn_source: 食物来源：指人类或动物获取食物的途径或来源。

sentences.c: Nonetheless advection is a more likely alternative food source.
sentences.cn_source: 尽管如此，平流是一种更可能的替代食物来源。

sentences.c: They replaced other minute organisms as a food source in the major marine food chain.
sentences.cn_source: 它们取代了其他微小生物，并成为了主要海洋食物链的食物来源。

sentences.c: They were an easily found and plentifully available food source in farming areas, especially for poor immigrants.
sentences.cn_source: 在农业地区，特别是对贫穷的移民来说，它们是一种很容易找到的、丰富的食物来源。

trans.cn: lượng thức ăn
trans.cn_source: 食物摄入

trans.cn: Lượng thức ăn ăn vào: là tổng lượng thức ăn mà một cá nhân tiêu thụ trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định.
trans.cn_source: 食物摄入量：指个体在一定时间内摄入的食物的总量。

sentences.c: Keeping a diary can help you work out your daily food intake more accurately.
sentences.cn_source: 记录日记可以帮你更准确地算出你每天的食物摄入量。

sentences.c: In a year's time, assuming no increase in food intake, you could lose ten pounds.
sentences.cn_source: 在一年的时间里，假设食物摄入量没有增加，你可以减掉10磅。

sentences.c: This shows that the relationship between hunger and food intake is more complex than we thought.
sentences.cn_source: 这表明饥饿和食物摄入之间的关系比我们想象的要复杂得多。

trans.cn: chuỗi thức ăn
trans.cn_source: 食物链

trans.cn: Chuỗi thức ăn: Một dạng tổ chức trong đó các sinh vật trong hệ sinh thái được sắp xếp theo thứ tự con mồi, trong đó mỗi sinh vật sử dụng các sinh vật ở cấp độ thấp hơn làm nguồn thức ăn.
trans.cn_source: 食物链：生态系统中生物按照捕食顺序排列的一种组织形式，每个生物都以比它更低层次的生物为食物来源。

sentences.c: Insects are fairly low down (on) the food chain.
sentences.cn_source: 在食物链中，昆虫是相当低的一级生物。

sentences.c: The whole food chain is affected by the overuse of chemicals in agriculture.
sentences.cn_source: 整个食物链因农业中过度使用化学制品而受到影响。

sentences.c: This poses a threat to agriculture and the food chain, and consequently to human health.
sentences.cn_source: 这会对农业和食物链造成威胁，由此而危及人的健康。

trans.cn: hộp đựng thức ăn
trans.cn_source: 食物容器

trans.cn: Hộp đựng thực phẩm: Hộp dùng để đựng và chứa thực phẩm, thường có đặc tính bịt kín để giữ cho thực phẩm luôn tươi ngon và hợp vệ sinh.
trans.cn_source: 食物容器：用于储存和盛放食物的容器，通常具有密封性能，可以保持食物的新鲜和卫生。

sentences.c: They also produce plastic food containers and wrap ice cream bar.
sentences.cn_source: 它们还能用于制造塑料食品包装容器或包扎雪糕等工作。

sentences.c: During a typical meal in space, a meal tray is used to hold the food containers.
sentences.cn_source: 太空中典型的伙食是用拖盘盛着食物盒来食用。

sentences.c: Waste reduction will be pursued, with reusable cups and limited use of food containers.
sentences.cn_source: 利用可再用杯和限制食物容器来减少垃圾。

trans.cn: cung cấp thực phẩm; cung cấp chất dinh dưỡng
trans.cn_source: 食品供应；养分供应

trans.cn: Cung cấp lương thực: là lượng lương thực được cung cấp để đáp ứng nhu cầu lương thực của con người.
trans.cn_source: 食品供应：指为满足人们的食品需求而提供的食品。

sentences.c: As hare numbers fall, so do lynx numbers, as their food supply depleted.
sentences.cn_source: 随着野兔数量的减少，猞猁数量也会减少，因为它们的食物供应已经耗尽。

sentences.c: When their food supply is sufficiently large, the lemmings live a normal, undisturbed life.
sentences.cn_source: 当食物供给量足够大时，旅鼠过着正常、不受干扰的生活。

sentences.c: For his contributions to the world food supply, Borlaug was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1970.
sentences.cn_source: 由于他对世界粮食供应的贡献，博洛格于1970年被授予诺贝尔和平奖。

sentences.c: If your back garden shed is cluttered with a broken lawnmower, rusty bicycles and a range of unused garden tools then prepare to be amazed.

sentences.c: The morning sun slanted through the glass roof.
sentences.cn_source: 朝阳透过玻璃屋顶斜射进来。

sentences.c: These black gridded frames also encompass a mono-pitched glass roof.
sentences.cn_source: 此外，倾斜的玻璃屋顶也采用了这种黑色网格框架。

sentences.c: A rear alleyway was enclosed WTH a glass roof to create a well-lit interior living room.
sentences.cn_source: 屋后的小弄堂则加盖了玻璃顶，为起居室内增添了光照效果。

trans.cn: Toàn cầu, trên toàn thế giới; toàn diện, tổng thể; (máy tính) toàn cầu; hình cầu
trans.cn_source: 全球的，全世界的；全面的，整体的；（计算机）全局的；球形的

sentences.c: Global warming is a real problem.
sentences.cn_source: 全球变暖是个确实存在的问题。

sentences.c: The plight of the Kurds gained global visibility.
sentences.cn_source: 库尔德人的困境受到了全球的关注。

sentences.c: The commission is calling for a global ban on whaling.
sentences.cn_source: 委员会要求全球禁止捕鲸。

trans.cn: thị trường toàn cầu
trans.cn_source: 全球市场

trans.cn: Thị trường toàn cầu: Đề cập đến tất cả những người trên khắp thế giới mua hoặc có thể muốn mua thứ gì đó.
trans.cn_source: 全球市场：指所有世界各地购买或可能想购买某种商品的人。

sentences.c: Farmers going grass-fed are not affected by the ever-changing milk prices of the global market.
sentences.cn_source: 用草饲养奶牛的农民不会受到全球市场不断波动的牛奶价格的影响。

sentences.c: I think this a global market.
sentences.cn_source: 我认为这是一个全球性的市场。

sentences.c: This is an extension of global market competitions.
sentences.cn_source: 这是全球范围市场竞争的延伸。

trans.cn: không có

trans.cn: Thanh toán toàn cầu: đề cập đến các giao dịch thanh toán xuyên biên giới quốc gia, bao gồm thanh toán điện tử xuyên biên giới, chuyển tiền xuyên biên giới, v.v.
trans.cn_source: 全球支付：指跨越国界的支付交易，包括跨境电子支付、跨境汇款等。

sentences.c: A coherent story of global payments imbalances and the financial crisis can be told without recourse to charges of an undervalued yuan.
sentences.cn_source: 用不着指控人民币汇率低估，也可以将全球收支失衡和金融危机的来龙去脉解释清楚。

sentences.c: The first is that global payments are significantly out of balance, with a huge US current account deficit offset by surpluses elsewhere.
sentences.cn_source: 第一，全球收支现在严重失衡，美国经常帐户赤字被其他国家的盈余抵消。

sentences.c: You cannot challenge fiat currencies and disrupt the global payments industry while reacting to any uninvited scrutiny like an adolescent whose parent has opened the bedroom door without knocking.
sentences.cn_source: 你不能一边挑战法币，颠覆全球支付行业，一边又对不请自来的关注暴跳如雷，就像因为父母没敲门就进卧室而大发脾气的少年一样。

trans.cn: sự nóng lên toàn cầu
trans.cn_source: 全球变暖

trans.cn: Sự nóng lên toàn cầu: đề cập đến sự gia tăng dần dần nhiệt độ của bề mặt trái đất, chủ yếu là do sự gia tăng phát thải khí nhà kính do các hoạt động của con người gây ra.
trans.cn_source: 全球变暖：指地球表面温度逐渐上升的现象，主要原因是人类活动导致的温室气体排放增加。

sentences.c: Global warming is a real problem.
sentences.cn_source: 全球变暖是个确实存在的问题。

sentences.c: Will global warming mean the spread of tropical parasitic diseases?
sentences.cn_source: 全球变暖将会意味着热带寄生虫病的传播吗？

sentences.c: Rich industrialized countries have sown the seeds of global warming.
sentences.cn_source: 富裕的工业化国家已经播下了使全球变暖的种子。

trans.cn: bầu cử chính phủ
trans.cn_source: 政府选举

trans.cn: Bầu cử chính phủ: đề cập đến các hoạt động bầu cử do chính phủ hoặc các cơ quan chính phủ tổ chức để bầu ra những người lãnh đạo hoặc đại diện của chính phủ.
trans.cn_source: 政府选举：指由政府或政府机构组织的选举活动，旨在选出政府的领导人或代表。

sentences.c: Papen lost a confidence vote in August, and his government fell after losing in the fourth election in a year in November.
sentences.cn_source: 帕彭在8月失去了一次信任投票，他的政府在11月的第四次选举中失败后垮台。

sentences.c: Will the government honour its election pledge not to raise taxes?
sentences.cn_source: 政府会履行它的竞选诺言，不增加税收吗？

sentences.c: The government which followed the election was a very different animal.
sentences.cn_source: 选举后的政府与前一届的截然不同。

trans.cn: Cơ quan nhà nước: là cơ quan do Nhà nước thành lập, quản lý và điều hành, chịu trách nhiệm thực hiện chức năng, nhiệm vụ của Nhà nước.
trans.cn_source: 政府机构：指由政府设立、管理和运作的机构，负责执行政府的职能和任务。

sentences.c: Government agencies must invest more funds in training and development programmes.
sentences.cn_source: 政府机构必须将更多的资金投入到培训和开发项目中。

sentences.c: Social media allows government agencies to spy on their own citizens.
sentences.cn_source: 社交媒体允许政府机构监视他们自己的公民。

sentences.c: To help track the ruffe's spread, government agencies have produced wallet-sized cards about the ruffe.
sentences.cn_source: 为了追踪梅花鲈的蔓延，政府机构制作了钱包大小的关于梅花鲈的卡片。

trans.cn: chính sách của chính phủ
trans.cn_source: 政府政策

trans.cn: Chính sách của chính phủ: đề cập đến các chủ trương, biện pháp và quy định do chính phủ xây dựng để đạt được các mục tiêu cụ thể.
trans.cn_source: 政府政策：指政府为了达成特定目标而制定的方针、措施和规定。

sentences.c: This speech may mark a change in government policy.
sentences.cn_source: 这篇演讲表明政府的政策可能会有变化。

sentences.c: He renewed his attack on government policy toward Europe.
sentences.cn_source: 他重新开始抨击政府的欧洲政策。

sentences.c: These latest developments argue a change in government policy.
sentences.cn_source: 最近的事态发展表明政府改变了政策。

sentences.cn_source: 实际的生活经验是三维的、比一个平面图更能清晰地表达。

trans.cn: thảo luận nhóm
trans.cn_source: 小组讨论

trans.cn: Thảo luận nhóm: Một cuộc thảo luận có sự tham gia của một số người có quan hệ với nhau thông qua một số hoạt động, sở thích hoặc đặc điểm chung.
trans.cn_source: 小组讨论：涉及一些通过某种共同活动、兴趣或特质相互联系的人之间的讨论。

sentences.c: Most people have individual study more than group discussion.
sentences.cn_source: 大多数人有个人研习多于集体讨论。

sentences.c: Slashdot focuses instead on group discussion and news-worthiness of links.
sentences.cn_source: 而Slashdot却将目光集中在了组讨论和链接的新闻价值上。

sentences.c: People make their minds up to varying degrees before they have a group discussion.
sentences.cn_source: 人们在开始群体讨论前对问题已经有了不同程度的决断。

trans.cn: Cuộc họp nhóm: Cuộc họp có sự tham gia của một nhóm người để thảo luận và giải quyết các vấn đề chung, xây dựng kế hoạch hoặc đưa ra quyết định.
trans.cn_source: 团队会议：由一组人员参与的会议，旨在讨论和解决共同的问题、制定计划或进行决策。

sentences.c: The instruction I always give at Buddhist student group meetings whenever somebody comes in and needs instruction is pretty simple.
sentences.cn_source: 每当有人进来需要指导时，我经常在佛教学生小组会议上给出的建议，都很简单。

sentences.c: Hold user group meetings.
sentences.cn_source: 主持用户组会议。

sentences.c: Many organizations publicize their programs in group meetings.
sentences.cn_source: 很多组织都会在团体会议上公布他们的方案。

trans.cn: Quy mô nhóm: đề cập đến số lượng cá nhân tạo nên một nhóm hoặc đơn vị xã hội.
trans.cn_source: 群体规模：指组成一个群体或社会单位的个体数量。

sentences.c: This modest group size allows our teachers to respond to the needs of each student.
sentences.cn_source: 这个适中的小组规模使得我们的老师们可以应对每个学生的需要。

sentences.c: The group size for this should remain Percentage with a value of 100.
sentences.cn_source: 这个组的大小中的 Percentage 值应该仍然保持为 100。

sentences.c: The default user group size is 100% running on the local computer (see Figure 38).
sentences.cn_source: 默认的用户组大小是100%运行在本地计算机上，如图38中所示。

trans.cn_source: 团体旅行：由一组人一起旅行的行程，通常由旅行社或组织者安排。

sentences.c: If you don't have a car, join a group trip for the day.
sentences.cn_source: 如果你没车，可以加入一个组团旅行团打发一天。

sentences.c: She also joined a group trip to go places she was uncomfortable in traveling alone, like visiting Morocco with Gap Adventures, which specializes in small group travel.
sentences.cn_source: 对于不适合独自旅行的地方，她还经常加入别的旅行团，比如随gap Adventures(专门组织小型旅游团)去游览摩洛哥。

sentences.c: Mr. Yang, with the Ningbo branch of Shanghai's Spring Travel, said that the couple was part ofa six-day group trip to Japan, which included a stay at Toyoko Inn in Nagoya.
sentences.cn_source: 据上海春天旅行社宁波分社的杨先生表示，这对夫妇参与了一趟前往日本6天旅游的旅行团，安排他们在名古屋的东横INN住宿。

trans.cn: vấn đề sức khỏe; chủ đề sức khỏe; tình trạng sức khỏe

trans.cn: Vấn đề sức khỏe: Đề cập đến sự khó chịu hoặc bất thường về thể chất hoặc tinh thần có thể cần được chăm sóc hoặc điều trị y tế.

sentences.c: In parts of South America, vitamin-A deficiency is a serious health problem, especially among children.
sentences.cn_source: 在南美部分地区，缺乏维生素 A 是一个严重的健康问题，尤其在儿童之中。

sentences.c: Since I started working in TB as a public health problem in 1996, we have been talking about the problems of drug management.
sentences.cn_source: 自从1996年我开始进行结核病作为公共卫生问题方面的工作，我们就一直在谈论药物管理的问题。

sentences.c: HIV is "a large and growing public health problem", according to Harvard Medical School genetic professor George Church.
sentences.cn_source: 艾滋病毒是“一个庞大且日益严重的公共卫生问题”，哈佛大学医学院遗传学教授乔治·丘奇表示。

trans.cn: Chăm sóc sức khỏe: Những nỗ lực của các chuyên gia được đào tạo và cấp phép để duy trì hoặc khôi phục trạng thái sức khỏe thể chất, tinh thần hoặc cảm xúc.
trans.cn_source: 医疗保健：通过受过训练和持有执照的专业人员进行的努力，以维护或恢复身体、心理或情感的健康状况。

sentences.c: Nobody wants to pay more for health care.
sentences.cn_source: 没人愿意为医疗保健花更多的钱。

sentences.c: Good health care is of primary importance.
sentences.cn_source: 良好的医疗保健是重中之重。

sentences.c: Health care should not become a political football.
sentences.cn_source: 保健问题不应该成为被踢来踢去的政治皮球。

sentences.cn_source: 节目突出报道了公共医疗机构的财政问题。

sentences.c: He heaped praise on his team.
sentences.cn_source: 他高度赞扬了他的队。

sentences.c: Even his praise is double-edged.
sentences.cn_source: 即使他的赞扬也是可以有两种解释的。

sentences.c: Praise is a great confidence booster.
sentences.cn_source: 表扬是一个很好的自信提升剂。

trans.cn: <Anh> Bị sa thải, bị sa thải; dư thừa, nặng nề; (được thiết lập để ngăn ngừa hư hỏng của các bộ phận chính trong máy hoặc hệ thống) tái định cư, dự phòng
trans.cn_source: <英> 被解雇的，被裁员的；多余的，累赘的；（为预防机器或系统中主要组件故障而设的）复置装置的，备用的

sentences.c: Changes in technology may mean that once-valued skills are now redundant.
sentences.cn_source: 技术的变化可能意味着从前受重视的技巧现在变得多余了。

sentences.c: This word is redundant, it can be left out.
sentences.cn_source: 这个字是多余的， 可以去掉。

sentences.c: Rather than maintaining the now redundant leaves throughout the winter, the tree saves its precious resources and discards them.
sentences.cn_source: 这棵树并没有在整个冬天都保留现在多余的叶子，而是储存了宝贵的资源并抛弃了多余的树叶。

trans.cn: Miễn cưỡng, miễn cưỡng
trans.cn_source: 勉强的，不情愿的

sentences.c: Mr. Spero was reluctant to ask for help.
sentences.cn_source: 斯珀洛先生不愿意请求帮助。

sentences.c: She was reluctant to admit she was wrong.
sentences.cn_source: 她不愿承认自己有错。

sentences.c: Most of the soldiers are reluctant conscripts.
sentences.cn_source: 大部分士兵都是不情愿的被征服役者。

trans.cn: Cơ bản, sơ bộ; chưa trưởng thành, chưa phát triển đầy đủ
trans.cn_source: 基本的，初步的；不成熟的，未充分发展的

sentences.c: Fossilized remains of Acanthostega, a primitive fish, reveal that even though the animal had rudimentary limbs, it could not walk on land.
sentences.cn_source: 棘螈是一种原始鱼类，它的化石遗迹显示，尽管棘螈有基本的四肢，但它却不能在陆地上行走。

sentences.c: He received rudimentary village schooling, but mostly he roamed his uncle's farm collecting the fossils that were so abundant in the rocks of the Cotswold hills.
sentences.cn_source: 他只在乡村学校接受了最基本的教育，但大部分时间都在叔叔的农场里游荡，收集科茨沃尔德丘陵中充裕的化石。

sentences.c: Some dinosaurs had only rudimentary teeth.
sentences.cn_source: 有些恐龙只有未充分长成的牙齿。

trans.cn: sự liên quan, sự hữu ích, ý nghĩa
trans.cn_source: 相关性，实用性，意义

sentences.c: Politicians' private lives have no relevance to their public roles.
sentences.cn_source: 政治家的私生活与他们的公众角色没有相关性。

sentences.c: Perhaps the students do not understand the relevance of the material to their studies.
sentences.cn_source: 也许学生们不理解这些材料与他们的学习的相关性。

sentences.c: Using the so-called Maxim of Relevance we can infer things as well, or rather the speaker can imply things and the listener can make inferences.
sentences.cn_source: 使用所谓的关联准则，我们可以推断出一些事情，或者更确切地说，说话者可以在话语中暗示一些内容，而听者可以从这些话语中做出推断。

trans.cn: Lặp lại, nói lại, làm lại; làm lại sự việc, nói lại lời nói; những thứ lặp đi lặp lại, những bản sao; (âm nhạc) sự lặp lại (các chương hoặc âm tiết); <cổ> tài liệu ngâm thơ do giáo viên chỉ định
trans.cn_source: 重复，重说，重做； 重做的事，重说的话；重复的事物，复制品；（乐）（章节或音节的）反复；<古>教师指定的背诵材料

sentences.c: It is real prayer, and not mechanical repetition.
sentences.cn_source: 这是真正的祈祷，而不是机械式的重复。

sentences.c: He could also have cut out much of the repetition and thus saved many pages.
sentences.cn_source: 他本来也可以删掉很多重复的语句，省去很多页数。

sentences.c: Repetition helps improve our memory.
sentences.cn_source: 重复有助于提高我们的记忆力。

trans.cn: Tự phát, không có kế hoạch; (chương trình, sự việc) tự phát, tự nhiên; (người) ngây thơ và thẳng thắn; (sinh học) (hoạt động cơ thể) bản năng

sentences.cn_source: 观众自发地鼓起掌来。

sentences.cn_source: 在大约第16至18周时我又一次自然流产了。

sentences.c: "Now my extroverted behaviour is spontaneous," he says.
sentences.cn_source: “现在我的外向行为是自发的。”他说。

sentences.c: And there isn't good public transportation from inner city Detroit to those suburban malls.
sentences.cn_source: 从底特律市中心到那些市郊的商场并没有好的公共交通。

sentences.c: Meg is a lawyer-mom in suburban Washington, D.C.
sentences.cn_source: 梅格是华盛顿郊区的一名律师妈妈。

sentences.c: At first sight it looked like a typical suburban road accident.
sentences.cn_source: 乍一看，这像是一起典型的郊区交通事故。

trans.cn_source: 表面地；浅薄地

sentences.c: Those copper articles were superficially brassed.
sentences.cn_source: 那些铜制器具表面镀了一层黄铜。

sentences.c: Thus art works themselves encourage us to view them superficially, without appreciating the richness of detail and labour that is involved.
sentences.cn_source: 因此，艺术作品本身鼓励我们从表面上看待它们，而不欣赏所涉及的细节和劳动的丰富性。

sentences.c: The film touches on these issues, but only superficially.
sentences.cn_source: 这部电影触及了这些问题，但很肤浅。

sentences.c: It is useless to speculate why he did it.
sentences.cn_source: 对他为什么这么做妄加猜测毫无用处。

sentences.c: It's always hard to speculate about the future.
sentences.cn_source: 推测未来总是很难的。

sentences.c: It's tempting to speculate about what might have happened.
sentences.cn_source: 大家不禁猜测，到底发生了什么事。

sentences.cn_source: 他迈着轻快的步伐出发了。

sentences.c: He took the ridiculous accusation in stride.
sentences.cn_source: 他从容应对那荒谬的指控。

sentences.c: The campaign is just getting into its stride.
sentences.cn_source: 这场运动刚刚进入状态。

sentences.c: Tomorrow we will transcend these as well, and the dreamers will deserve a lot of the credit.
sentences.cn_source: 明天我们也将超越这些成就，且梦想家们将会得到更多的荣誉。

sentences.c: Baudelaire regarded photography as "a very humble servant of art and science"; a medium largely unable to transcend "external reality".
sentences.cn_source: 波德莱尔认为摄影是“艺术和科学的一个非常卑微的仆人”；是一种很大程度上无法超越“外部现实”的媒介。

sentences.c: Both Martin Luther King and John Kennedy appealed to the idea that humans can transcend what were once considered inherent limitations.
sentences.cn_source: 马丁·路德·金和约翰·肯尼迪都发起呼吁，倡导人类能够超越曾经被认为是固有局限性的观点。

sentences.cn_source: 你还是抓紧处理这个问题为好。

sentences.c: We must tackle the problem with sympathy and understanding.
sentences.cn_source: 我们必须带着同情和谅解来处理这个问题。

trans.cn_source: 可望成功的，切实可行的；能存活的，能生长发育的

sentences.c: The plane will be commercially viable if 400 can be sold.
sentences.cn_source: 这飞机若能售出400架从商业上看就可行。

sentences.c: If industrial agriculture is to be replaced, what is a viable alternative?
sentences.cn_source: 如果工业化农业要被取代，那么可行的替代方案是什么呢？

sentences.c: These farmers will never actually sell any of the lands, provided that farming it remains viable.
sentences.cn_source: 实际上，只要耕种仍然可行，这些农民不会出售任何土地。

sentences.cn_source: 我们仍然在设法选定一个会场。

sentences.cn_source: 会场被3 000名俱乐部会员挤得满满的。

sentences.cn_source: 世界杯的举办地点尚未确定。

sentences.c: Its spaceship was engineered by Bert Rutan, renowned for designing the Voyager.
sentences.cn_source: 它的飞船由伯特·鲁坦设计建造，此人因设计“旅行者”号飞船而闻名。

sentences.c: The solution was to get a message to Voyager I to instruct it to use spares to change the failing parts.
sentences.cn_source: 解决办法是给旅行者1号发信息，指示它使用备件更换故障部件。

sentences.c: The space probe, Voyager I, launched in 1977, had sent back spectacular images of Jupiter and Saturn and then soared out of the Solar System on a one-way mission to the stars.
sentences.cn_source: 1977年发射的“旅行者一号”太空探测器发回了木星和土星的壮观图像，然后飞出太阳系，执行前往恒星的单程任务。

sentences.cn_source: 只有少数几个人回到附近地区工作。

sentences.cn_source: 在车站附近有大约一百家左右的旅馆。
